requirements.title: Hardened disposable execution sandbox
requirements.source_claim: Each issue or candidate should execute in an isolated sandbox with bounded resources and cleanup.
requirements.real_problem: A Docker container with bridge networking, writable root, shell clone and broad mounts is not zero-egress or hardened isolation.
requirements.state_machine: POLICY_BOUND → SANDBOX_CREATED → WORKLOAD_ADMITTED → EXECUTED → ARTIFACTS_CAPTURED → CLEANUP_VERIFIED
positive_controls: default-deny egress and privilege controls turn red when violated
blockers: exact runtime profile and host policy not bound
requirements.next_transition: Route to Agent Shield and runtime-env; compile concrete P7 command after owner admission.

requirements.title: Exact source and code identity gates
requirements.source_claim: Code and report claims should bind to physical source locations before writeback.
requirements.real_problem: Path existence, line bounds and a partial AST symbol scan do not prove commit/tree, symlink-normalized path, snippet or parser identity.
requirements.state_machine: CLAIM_BOUND → EXACT_SUBJECT_CAPTURED → READ_BACK → PHYSICAL_GATES → SEMANTIC_REVIEW → FINAL_RECEIPT
positive_controls: path traversal and symlink escape are refused
mutation_controls: symbol found elsewhere counted as match
blockers: owner schemas and exact language coverage not bound
requirements.next_transition: Emit A3 owner packet to Truth Verify/OpenWiki/Bettor code-truth owners.

requirements.title: Semantic verification with abstention and repair limits
requirements.source_claim: Draft claims may be checked by NLI or a judge and repaired when contradicted.
requirements.real_problem: A probabilistic judge cannot guarantee zero hallucination and repair cannot invent replacement facts.
requirements.state_machine: CLAIM_SEGMENTED → EVIDENCE_BOUND → SUPPORTED | REFUTED | CONFLICTED | ABSTAIN → REPAIR_CANDIDATE | HUMAN_REVIEW
positive_controls: unsupported and conflicted claims remain visible
repair requires new or stronger evidence
mutation_controls: repair changes claim without new evidence
requirements.next_transition: Bind semantic evidence contract and Human review conditions.

requirements.title: Four-dimensional Code/Model/Data/Trace provenance
requirements.source_claim: Code, model, data and trace components should be screened for commercial-use constraints and lineage.
requirements.real_problem: A root SPDX whitelist or model-generated interpretation cannot close dependency, custom terms, data rights, privacy or provider ToS.
requirements.state_machine: SUBJECT_DISCOVERED → EXACT_VERSION_CAPTURED → LINEAGE_RESOLVED → OBLIGATIONS_EVALUATED → POLICY_CANDIDATE | BLOCKED | HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED
positive_controls: unknown/custom terms remain UNKNOWN or HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED
SBOM and data-flow subjects are exact
blockers: dimension owner implementations and legal/security review absent
requirements.next_transition: Compile A4 owner packets; do not claim legal advice.

requirements.title: Sanitize-before-export telemetry with explicit egress evidence
requirements.source_claim: Local OpenTelemetry, Langfuse or ClickHouse may collect traces and quality metrics.
requirements.real_problem: Running local telemetry components does not prove zero leakage, safe retention, tenant isolation or sanitizer ordering.
requirements.state_machine: PAYLOAD_CLASSIFIED → SANITIZED → POLICY_CHECKED → EXPORTED_OR_DROPPED → STORED → RETENTION/DELETION_VERIFIED
positive_controls: raw secrets and PII never reach exporter input
negative network control blocks non-allowlisted endpoint
blockers: selected telemetry stack and data-flow map not bound
requirements.next_transition: Route telemetry policy and canaries to A4 owner lanes.
